integrity: Proof is analytic. Standalone finite numerical tests are supplementary and do not certify universal claims. Historical priority is subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness is only among fixed-volume balanced two-by-two axis ellipsoids in dimension four, not among general ellipsoids; exact result is implicit in a one-dimensional integral; numerical values are approximate; independent review remains unperformed.
title: Unique nonspherical maximizer of random planar-section diameters for balanced four-ellipsoids
